visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled dark hair wearing a black t-shirt and a 'Rode' microphone stands in front of a brightly lit cosmetics counter. He points toward the camera and makes animated facial expressions. (2) He introduces a female makeup artist with blonde hair tied back, wearing a black blazer. They stand together in the department store setting surrounded by mirrors and beauty product displays. (3) The man holds a black compact, which opens to reveal a light purple blush powder. Close-up shots show the makeup artist's finger swatching the purple powder on the man's forearm, demonstrating its brightening effect on his skin tone. (4) The scene shifts to the man's face as the artist uses a large brush to apply the purple blush to his upper cheekbones. A split-screen comparison shows one side of his face significantly brighter and smoother than the other. (5) They move to an eyeshadow display with various colorful pans. The man points to a palette of neutral and warm tones. (6) Close-up swatches are shown on a forearm for a rose-toned eyeshadow and a glittery gold eyeshadow, highlighting the texture and shimmer. (7) The makeup artist presents a black lipstick tube. She swatches a nude pink shade on the man's arm next to the eyeshadow swatches. (8) The man concludes the video by standing in the middle of the store, gesturing enthusiastically toward the brand's signage above him.

(2) A sharp 'Ding' SFX punctuates a transition, followed by a friendly female voice with moderate pitch and high clarity. (3) A subtle mechanical click is heard as a makeup compact opens, layered over the continuous upbeat music. (4) Multiple 'Whoosh' and 'Pop' sound effects are synchronized with visual text overlays appearing on screen while the male and female voices alternate in a conversational manner. (5) The male voice rises in intensity and volume as he expresses excitement, accompanied by a cartoonish 'boing' SFX. (6) The video concludes with the BGM fading out quickly after a final high-energy spoken phrase by the male speaker.
